title: Algebraization from bounded exceptional torsion and closed thickenings
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use algebraic spaces over $S$ and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Modules, tensor pullback and direct image are on these ringed sites [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module, def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I\subseteq A$, and assume $A\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A/I^n$. Fix $\operatorname{Spec}A\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], a separated finite-type algebraic space $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties], and a quasi-coherent ideal $K\subseteq\mathcal O_X$. Put $J=I\mathcal O_X$, and for $e\geq1$ let $X_e^K\hookrightarrow X$ be the closed subspace cut out by $K^e$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Coherent modules, adic systems and the bounded-kernel convention are [def-sfb-space-coherent-adic-system]; proper support is the closed-carrier convention [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor]. Assume, for every $e\geq1$, completion is an equivalence from coherent modules on $X_e^K$ with support proper over $A$ to $\mathrm{Coh}(X_e^K,J\mathcal O_{X_e^K})$ with proper support. Let $M\in\mathrm{Coh}(X,J)$ have proper support. Suppose a coherent module $H$ on $X$ with proper support and a map $a:M\to\widehat H_J$ are given, such that some power $K^t$ kills every ordinary component kernel and cokernel of $a$. Then there are a coherent module $F$ on $X$ with proper support over $A$ and an isomorphism $\widehat F_J\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ of adic systems. No flatness is assumed.

proof.text: $X$ is Noetherian by the finite-type separated inheritance statement of [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-acc]. Work with the componentwise definitions in [def-sfb-space-coherent-adic-system]. For $e\geq1$ put $Q_{e,n}=M_n/K^eM_n$. Quotients are coherent by the affine-chart calculus and Noetherian coherence. The identities $Q_{e,n+1}/J^nQ_{e,n+1}=M_{n+1}/(K^e+J^n)M_{n+1}\simeq Q_{e,n}$ show that $Q_e=(Q_{e,n})_n$ is $J$-adic. Its first term is a quotient of $M_1$, hence has proper support: stalk support decreases under quotients, and the proper-support closed-subset and carrier statements apply. The dictionary [lem-sfb-space-closed-adic-dictionary], applied to the ideal $K^e$, identifies $Q_e$ with a coherent adic system on the Noetherian closed subspace $X_e^K$, preserving proper support and commuting with completion. The assumed equivalence gives a coherent proper-support module $G_e$ killed by $K^e$, with a chosen isomorphism $\widehat G_{e,J}\simeq Q_e$.

Both $Q_{e+1}$ and $Q_e$ have coherent terms killed by $K^{e+1}$; the dictionary identifies them, with proper support, on $X_{e+1}^K$. Fullness of the assumed completion equivalence there lifts $Q_{e+1}\to Q_e$ to $G_{e+1}\to G_e$. All equalities of its composites hold by faithfulness. Since $(G_{e+1}/K^eG_{e+1})/J^n=G_{e+1}/(K^e+J^n)G_{e+1}\simeq Q_{e,n}$, both $G_{e+1}/K^eG_{e+1}$ and $G_e$ complete to $Q_e$; full faithfulness gives $G_{e+1}/K^eG_{e+1}\simeq G_e$ with the prescribed quotient map. The quotient has proper support by the closed-subset and carrier statements. Thus $N=(G_e)_e$ is $K$-adic with proper support. The chosen completion isomorphisms form an isomorphism of double diagrams $\sigma_{e,n}:G_e/J^nG_e\simeq M_n/K^eM_n$. Here the only quotient identity used is $(P/LP)/TP=P/(L+T)P$, checked on affine charts.

The maps $a_n$ modulo $K^e$ give $Q_{e,n}\to H/(J^n+K^e)H$. The dictionary identifies $G_e$ and $H/K^eH$ with coherent modules on $X_e^K$ and identifies their completion diagrams naturally, including quotient transitions. Fullness of the assumed completion equivalence there gives $d_e:G_e\to H/K^eH$. Both its source and target have proper support. Faithfulness on $X_{e+1}^K$ shows that these maps commute with $e$-transitions, since their completions do. Thus $d:N\to\widehat H_K$ satisfies the comparison square with $a$ and $\sigma$. Quotient interchange is induced by the two projections from $H$, so this square is precisely the square required by [lem-sfb-space-second-adic-torsion-transfer]. That lemma gives $K^{4t}\ker d_e=K^{4t}\operatorname{coker}d_e=0$ for every $e$.

Apply [lem-sfb-space-easy-torsion-algebraization] with completion ideal $K$, system $N$ and map $d$. Obtain coherent $F$, $b:F\to H$ with actual kernel and cokernel killed by $K^s$ for some $s\geq1$, and $\gamma:N\simeq\widehat F_K$ with $d=\widehat b_K\gamma$. No proper-support assertion is taken from this lemma. For every $n$, reduction of $b$ modulo $J^n$ still has kernel and cokernel killed by $K^{2s}$: locally for $f,g\in K^s$, lift $fy$ through $b$ and multiply the lift by $g$. This defines $c_{fg}:H\to F$, independently of the lift, with $c_{fg}b=fg$ and $bc_{fg}=fg$. After quotienting by $J^n$ these identities show that $fg$ kills both errors. Products $fg$ generate $K^{2s}$. This is a computation of ordinary module maps on the cited affine charts. It uses no exactness of tensor pullback. Also $(M_n/K^eM_n)_e$ is $K$-adic by the quotient identities.

Fix $n$. Apply the easy torsion-algebraization lemma to the $K$-adic completion of $a_n:M_n\to H/J^nH$. Its component errors are killed by $K^{2t}$, by the same product-lift calculation as in step 4 applied to $a_n$ and quotient ideal $K^e$. One admissible triple is $(M_n,a_n,\mathrm{id})$. Another is $(F/J^nF,b\bmod J^n,\gamma_n)$: $\gamma_n$ is obtained by quotienting $\gamma$ by $J^n$ and using $\sigma_{e,n}$ and $(F/K^eF)/J^n=F/(K^e+J^n)F$. The comparison square from step 3 gives the required equality over $H/J^nH$, and step 4 gives the actual torsion bound. Uniqueness of the triple supplies an isomorphism $\varphi_n:F/J^nF\simeq M_n$. To check the $n$-transition, reduce $\varphi_{n+1}$ modulo $J^n$ and use the defining adic identifications. This produces another isomorphism of the same triples at $n$, because $\sigma$, $\gamma$ and $a$ commute with transitions. Uniqueness forces it to equal $\varphi_n$. Hence $(\varphi_n)_n:\widehat F_J\simeq M$.

It remains to prove proper support of $F$. At a geometric stalk outside $V(K)$, $K^s$ is the unit ideal, so $\ker b$ vanishes. Its support is therefore contained in $\operatorname{Supp}(F)\cap V(K)=\operatorname{Supp}(F/KF)=\operatorname{Supp}(G_1)$. For the middle equality, at a point of $V(K)$ the ideal $K$ is in the maximal ideal of the local ring; if $F/KF=0$, the finite-module Nakayama statement [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-one-plus-ideal-annihilator] gives an annihilator congruent to $1$ modulo $K$, hence a unit, so $F=0$ there. Finiteness and coherent kernels follow on charts from the cited calculus and Noetherian coherence. In the stalkwise exact sequence $0\to\ker b\to F\to\operatorname{im}b\to0$, the image has support contained in $\operatorname{Supp}(H)$, so $\operatorname{Supp}(F)\subseteq\operatorname{Supp}(G_1)\cup\operatorname{Supp}(H)$. This union is proper, and its closed subset $\operatorname{Supp}(F)$ is proper. The carrier equivalence gives a proper closed carrier for $F$, as required.

lean.statement: theorem coherentAdic_algebraization_of_bounded_exceptional_torsion {S : Scheme.{u}} {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] (aS : Spec (.of A) ⟶ S) (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (Over.mk aS)) (hsep : MapIsSeparated f) (hft : MapIsFiniteType f) (J K : QuasiCoherentIdeal X) (hJ : ∀ T : X.EtaleSite, IsAffine (X.etaleForget.obj T) → idealSectionImage J.val.arrow T = Ideal.map (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ (yoneda.preimage (T.obj.hom ≫ f.hom.hom)).left.appTop).hom) I) (hthickenings : ∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → (∀ F G : CoherentProperSupportModules f, AdicPowerKills K e F.obj → AdicPowerKills K e G.obj → Function.Bijective (fun v : F ⟶ G ↦ (coherentAdicCompletionDiagram J).map v.hom)) ∧ (∀ N : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules, IsCoherentAdicSystem J N → CoherentAdicHasProperSupportOver f N → (∀ n : ℕ, AdicPowerKills K e (N.obj (op n))) → ∃ F : CoherentProperSupportModules f, AdicPowerKills K e F.obj ∧ Nonempty ((coherentAdicCompletionDiagram J).obj F.obj ≅ N))) (M : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (hM : IsCoherentAdicSystem J M) (hMproper : CoherentAdicHasProperSupportOver f M) (H : CoherentProperSupportModules f) (a : M ⟶ (coherentAdicCompletionDiagram J).obj H.obj) (ha : CoherentAdicKernelCokernelKilled K a) : ∃ F : CoherentProperSupportModules f, Nonempty ((coherentAdicCompletionDiagram J).obj F.obj ≅ M)
